opennyai_summary.decision:
2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 601/2021 of Police Station Seema Puri for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act on the ground that respondent no.2 has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
It appears that husband of respondent no.2 (son of petitioners) unfortunately passed away during Covid.
After some discussion, both sides request that the matter be placed before Joint Registrar, where respondent no.2 shall make categorical statement that she shall not claim any maintenance or inheritance on behalf of her daughters from the petitioners.
7. Out of the total settlement amount of Rs. 75,00,000/-, a sum of Rs. 37,50,000/- has already been paid by petitioners to respondent no.2.
The balance amount may be paid before the Joint Registrar after recording of statement of respondent no.2.
